title: Theatre Within a Painting
description: A large surreal canvas leans against the wall of a dark, abandoned institutional hall with a starry skylight. The painting depicts a decaying theatre interior with a glowing red door, stage, wooden chair, and blood-red liquid spilling from the canvas onto the concrete floor where a director's chair, boombox, and broken star-shaped object sit.
prompt: surreal scene of a massive leaning canvas inside a dark abandoned hall with concrete floors and starry skylight. The painting shows a decaying theatre with red door, stage and wooden chair. Red liquid spills from the canvas onto the floor. In front of the canvas sits a director's chair with coffee and bottle, an old boombox, and a broken star object. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed
